name: recurring-buy-npm
description: The same checks for a project scaffolded with --package-manager npm. Point validators.commands at this file in such a project.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install workspace dependencies the way create-scaffold-hbar does.

commands.name: lint
commands.command: npm run next:lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run hardhat:lint -- --max-warnings=0
commands.purpose: Lint both packages with zero warnings allowed.

commands.name: build
commands.command: npm run hardhat:compile && npm run next:build
commands.purpose: Compile contracts and build the Next.js app (includes type checks).
